source_cautions: v2 attributes the recursive V-poset characterization to Hasebe–Tsujie Theorem4.3; the older author PDF attributes it differently.
Lemma8 contains a cardinality equality false for two independent looped vertices; restricting to extensions beginning with the chosen vertex repairs that local proof step.
The printed forbidden-bowtie definition omits one comparability; the authored proof uses only the recursive V definition.
